intro.text: The Shin custodians of the Honorblades, each leading a monastery dedicated to preserving and mastering its powers.

description.text: Candidates train with the different Honorblades, defeat a bearer without using powers, and seek the other bearers' approval on a second pilgrimage.
The Bondsmith Honorbearer is chosen by a vote instead.
Pozen dominated the Honorbearers during Szeth's training, despite the Bondsmith's traditional seniority.

items.text: Under the Heralds' guidance, the Shin built monasteries and kept the Honorblades ready for the Voidbringers' return.
Ishar used stolen power from Odium's perpendicularity to influence the Honorbearers as the Voice. His influence helped turn them against Szeth's warnings.
Ishar made corrupted Honorbearers able to take new bodies after death. Sivi rejected him.
Ishar ordered Szeth to make a pilgrimage through the monasteries.
Szeth defeated Rit and recovered Talenel's Blade.
He found Sivi dead and recovered Kalak's Blade.
He destroyed the Edgedancer Honorbearer with Nightblood in Shadesmar, while Pozen killed himself with his Blade.
Szeth overcame Moss, while Kaladin saved him from the hidden Truthwatcher Honorbearer.
Ishar recalled Elid before Szeth could finish reaching his sister.
When the corrupted bearers returned to fight him, Szeth used Nightblood to destroy them permanently.
The renewed Oathpact returned the Blades to the Heralds, ending the need for their Shin custodians.
